messages:
sara-ml: Heads-up — ran a prefetch slew-rate sweep against magnet16b on int8+prefetch throttle. Seeing intermittent KV index gaps for longprefill > 120k tokens. Repro rate ~3/50 runs.
chao: Can you paste the exact run command? @devops-bot any throttles in the pipeline?
sara-ml: `./run_kv_slew.sh --model magnet16b --quant int8 --prefetch 1..10 --max-prefill 200000` logs excerpt: 
```
KVCACHE: prefetch window=131072 start=0 end=131072
KVCACHE: index_write at 65520 -> hole detected
TRACE: rope_pos 131020 -> mapped to shard 3
```
ben-ryan: Hmm hole at 65520 looks like fencepost + tiling mismatch, maybe our prefetch stride is not aligned with shard tile size.
kim: This only started after the new prefetch slew limiter landed yesterday. Rolling it back for a test?
sara-ml: Rolled to canary 2026-03-20T03:12 — still see 1/20 failures. Failure mode: generation returns short output (truncated) and subsequent requests for the same session return shifted tokens.
chao: Can you repro with single-threaded run and no batching?
sara-ml: Yes — single-threaded with `--batch 1` still repros. Will run with debug flags `KV_DUMP=1 ROPE_CHECK=1` and upload dumps.
devops-bot: deploybot: canary rollback triggered for prefetch-slew-limiter on eng-ml cluster #3 :truck: 
ben-ryan: Thanks. If it's alignment, quick mitigation is to clamp prefetch stride to tile_size and add assert in write path.
sara-ml: Opening a quick PR with assert and a tight unit test. Tagging @chao for review. Repro traces and KV dumps in the thread.
chao: lgtm to investigate. Also let's run a quant-compare (fp16 vs int8) to rule out quant packing bug.
kim: FYI adding to next stand-up agenda — this could be a regression in cache priming.
sara-ml: Will post repro script and seed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
